contracts.note: Absent policy alone does not prove an actual wrong verdict for current integer-only domains. Counterexamples are distinguished from preventative policy binding.

verification.grounded: Read all 90 current typed KP objectives, constraints, 360 exemplar problems, and complete selected-template bodies/domains/sketches/hints. Every current raw curriculum file equals the authoring packet source commit, so its prerequisite metadata is unchanged.
verification.tested: Independent Python recomputation matched all 1,096 complete finite-domain samples. Checked exact parameter/sample coverage and frozen artifact hashes. Used existing compiled content_audit_facts to load current curriculum.
verification.inferred: Legacy wrong-answer counterexamples follow inspected propagation/checker code and an existing regression test; the benchmark scope concern is explicitly uncertain.
verification.not_verified: No new Rust builds/tests, no new mechanical template/instruction gate run for these 90, no API writes or live approvals, and no full semantic reread of all 360 curriculum solution sketches in this pass.
